_note: Tier-1 sweep batch 009, January-March 2024. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He warns of standing before the great throne with an empty cup and hearing that you did nothing on this earth, and prays mercy over it.
mentions.quote: you did nothing for me on this Earth woe unto you
mentions.condition_text: conditioned on how the hearer spends their life
mentions.falsify_match: Not scoreable by ordinary evidence.

mentions.claim_text: He introduces a review of eight words given nine months earlier that he says are coming to pass, noting he has only been broadcasting about six months.
mentions.quote: some of the things that are coming to past
mentions.falsify_match: Not scoreable on its own; it frames the eight claims that follow.

mentions.claim_text: He describes figures in small red berets who want to kill everybody, and repeats that he warned about the 2024 elections and prayed over Michelle Obama after being shown something about her.
mentions.quote: they had those hats on those Red Hats it look like Berets
mentions.falsify_match: Michelle Obama enters the 2024 race, alongside a red-bereted militant group becoming visible.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats that he told listeners something is happening with crypto, disclaims financial advice, and restates that he sees and hears only in part.
mentions.quote: I told you all about something happening with crypto
mentions.falsify_match: A major move in crypto after January 2024.

mentions.claim_text: He points to Jamie Dimon warning that very powerful forces will impact the US economy in 2024 as fruit of what he said was coming.
mentions.quote: Jamie Diamond warns all these very powerful forces will impact US economy
mentions.falsify_match: Powerful economic shocks hit the US in 2024 as Dimon warned.

mentions.claim_text: A depression worse than the 1930s is trying to come and he allows it might be stopped or lessened; he has warned about 2025 and says a great war is coming with wars and rumours of wars.
mentions.quote: worse than the 1930s major major major depression coming trying to come
mentions.condition_text: he says maybe it can be stopped or lessened
mentions.falsify_match: A depression on or beyond 1930s scale beginning around 2025.
mentions.falsify_miss: No depression, which he pre-frames as possibly lessened.

mentions.claim_text: Banks seize the money in banking accounts and it goes into a digital dollar coming out soon, which he says is already starting to manifest.
mentions.quote: banks would seize the money in the banking accounts
mentions.falsify_match: US bank deposits are seized and converted into a digital currency.
mentions.falsify_miss: No seizure and no digital dollar.

mentions.claim_text: He saw people crossing not only from Mexico but from all over the world during 2024, driven by fear of who would take the next administration.
mentions.quote: it wasn't just about people from Mexico it was people from all over the world
mentions.falsify_match: Border crossings in 2024 come from a markedly wider set of origin countries.

mentions.claim_text: Offering it as his opinion rather than a word, he says he believes with all his heart there is financial breakthrough and a turnaround coming for the body of Christ in 2024.
mentions.quote: do I believe we're going to see Financial breakthrough in 2024 yes
mentions.falsify_match: Not independently scoreable; a blessing over the audience.

mentions.claim_text: He points to the significance of the eclipse coming on 8 April and to a conference on the end times and signs of the times.
mentions.quote: how significant even this eclipse is coming on the 8th of April
mentions.falsify_match: A significant event coincides with the 8 April 2024 eclipse.
mentions.falsify_miss: The eclipse passes as an ordinary astronomical event.

mentions.claim_text: He plays John Kilpatrick saying the second warning of this kind he ever gave his congregation was on 19 December 2019, before COVID, when everything still looked normal.
mentions.quote: December the 19th 2019 I came before the church everything was still normal
mentions.falsify_match: Kilpatrick gave a warning to his church on 19 December 2019, weeks before COVID surfaced.

mentions.claim_text: In Kilpatrick's account a televised meteorologist reports a great low pressure system in the Pacific moving into the Pacific Northwest.
mentions.quote: there's a system in the Pacific and it's coming in in the Pacific Northwest
mentions.falsify_match: Not scoreable as weather; it is the source image for his own low-pressure framing.

mentions.claim_text: The system moves south over parts of America and the Pacific rain reaches the Gulf Coast by the middle of the following week, after which the Holy Spirit speaks to Kilpatrick.
mentions.quote: by the middle of next week will be along the Gulf Coast
mentions.falsify_match: Not scoreable as weather; part of the quoted vision.

mentions.claim_text: The word given before the 2020 election was pockets of turbulence, including civil war and terrorism, but nothing that engulfs the whole world.
mentions.quote: Pockets of turbulence nothing engulfs the whole world
mentions.falsify_match: Localised conflicts and terrorism without a general world war.
mentions.falsify_miss: Either a world war or an entirely calm period.

mentions.claim_text: Major events are about to take place with Israel and the signs of the times escalate, with Passover about a month away and a great escalation attached to it.
mentions.quote: the Lord said there was a great escalation
mentions.falsify_match: A sharp escalation involving Israel during April 2024.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord warns him about what the enemy is planning and plotting, that he does not fear it, and that the sheep know the shepherd's voice.
mentions.quote: the Lord will warn me about things that the enemy is planning
mentions.falsify_match: Not scoreable; a statement about how he receives warnings.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not scoreable; a statement about method.

mentions.claim_text: He calls the events mile markers of a bigger end times sequence and names the American eclipse of 8 April as one, saying it is snowballing.
mentions.quote: the big American Eclipse taking place on the 8th of April
mentions.falsify_match: A significant event coincides with the 8 April 2024 eclipse.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord spoke to him about an acceleration at Passover, which he places at the end of April, around 21 April.
mentions.quote: he was talking to me about an acceleration at Passover
mentions.falsify_match: A marked acceleration of events around Passover 2024.

mentions.claim_text: His instruction for 2024 is to meditate on love and get rooted and grounded in love and in the word, so as to be stable while everything else fades away.
mentions.quote: 2024 is meditate on love and get that down inside of me
mentions.falsify_match: Not scoreable; an instruction.

mentions.claim_text: He reports a word received in rhyme and imperfect metre: Christ takes up his throne on earth, evil is removed, and the glory is here to be told far and near.
mentions.quote: the glory is here it is all rhyming and imperfect meter
mentions.falsify_match: Not scoreable by ordinary evidence.

mentions.claim_text: He says we are in the end times and manifestations of the glory of God are starting through dreams, signs, wonders and visions, with the best yet to come.
mentions.quote: we're in the end times we are seeing manifestations of the glory of God
mentions.falsify_match: A documented rise in reported signs and visions.

mentions.claim_text: He encourages listeners not to give up on what they believe for, saying the manifestations will come because the price has already been paid.
mentions.quote: the manifestations of it will come don't give up
mentions.falsify_match: Not scoreable; an instruction.

mentions.claim_text: He says 2024 will be a good year for the hearer if they believe, making it explicitly a matter of the hearer's faith and gratitude.
mentions.quote: believe this year 2024 will be a good year for you
mentions.falsify_match: Not independently scoreable once conditioned on the hearer's own faith.

mentions.claim_text: He explains what happens if something were to happen to the channel, points to his wife's channel Come Thrift with Me, and sets out their goal for 2024 alongside homeschooling.
mentions.quote: our goal is what we're going to do in 2024
mentions.falsify_match: Not scoreable; channel housekeeping.

mentions.claim_text: He describes going on Mediterranean keto and detoxing from sugar through early January, saying the Lord kept telling him he had no choice.
mentions.quote: the Lord kept saying you don't have a choice you've got to do this
mentions.falsify_match: Not scoreable; a personal health instruction.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not scoreable; a personal health instruction.
